summary: editable-contracts preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js in the package root via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line blob with obfuscator.io fingerprints (shuffled string/constant array plus a rotator function, randomized 6-8 character identifiers) whose source is not shipped or referenced anywhere. The package advertises itself as a JSON-editable-contracts library and has no functional need to fetch a language runtime or execute a large opaque payload at install. Using an alternate runtime (Bun) to execute the sibling payload bypasses scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code paths, and the payload's contents cannot be meaningfully audited due to obfuscation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
